notes: Read SKILL.md (535 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and TypeScript samples for @azure/storage-queue: authentication options, queue create/list/delete, send/receive/peek/update/delete/clear messages, worker and poison-message patterns, message encoding, and SAS generation.

Tells the agent to `npm install @azure/storage-queue @azure/identity` (SKILL.md:19) and shows auth via DefaultAzureCredential, account keys, connection strings, or SAS tokens read from environment variables (SKILL.md:28-31, 61-91); operations send, delete, and clear messages and delete queues in the user's storage account. The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for the package install and live-credential, state-changing operations; acceptable because packages are official and all actions target the user's own storage account.

clearMessages (SKILL.md:250) and queue delete (SKILL.md:130-133) are irreversible and shown ungated; the account SAS example grants broad permissions ('rwdlacupi', SKILL.md:433) for 24 hours, so users should scope SAS tokens narrowly. Skill itself recommends Entra ID over keys (SKILL.md:518).
